# Beyond the S-matrix {#sec-beyond-smatrix}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false title="Learning goals"}
- Compute ground-state energies and central charges with the thermodynamic Bethe ansatz.
- Understand the form-factor programme.
- State the exact mass–coupling relation.
- Meet the ODE/IM correspondence.
- Know what has been proved rigorously at real coupling.
:::
